metadata.title: HoloLoom AI-Ready Data Architecture Implementation Roadmap
metadata.based_on: Salesforce 2024 Enterprise Data Survey (6000+ data leaders)
metadata.core_problem: 84% of enterprises need complete data strategy overhaul before AI works
metadata.perception_gap: 63% of executives think they're data-driven, but data isn't ready for AI
metadata.success_rate: Only 16% successfully scaling AI (this roadmap targets that cohort)
metadata.estimated_timeline: 18-36 months full deployment (honest, not vendor promises)
metadata.philosophy: Diagnose before deploy, build infrastructure first, be honest about timeline

hololoom_strengths.value: Performance tiers for different use cases
Concurrent feature extraction, retrieval, warp tensioning

hololoom_strengths.capability: Risk-based action gating, audit trail, alignment framework
Type safety, clear interfaces, modular backends
Phases 0-5 complete (gradient flow, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, wave mechanics, statistical mechanics)
hololoom_strengths.value: Self-optimizing intelligence with zero manual tuning

critical_gaps.impact: Cannot answer 'What is inventory for product X?' in <5 seconds
critical_gaps.required_capability: Structured queries (exact entity lookups, JOINs, aggregations)

critical_gaps.impact: Still copying data into HoloLoom (shards = copies, becomes stale)
critical_gaps.required_capability: Federated queries to source systems (Salesforce, Jira, Stripe) at agent runtime

critical_gaps.impact: Cannot distinguish revenue_type (one-time vs recurring), leads to wrong ARR calculations
critical_gaps.current_capability: Unstructured metadata (Dict[str, Any]), no business ontology
critical_gaps.required_capability: Business ontology (ARR, MRR, churn definitions), structured schemas (Pydantic), validation

critical_gaps.impact: Bad data silently corrupts knowledge graph, no alerts, no owner to page
critical_gaps.required_capability: Automated quality checks (completeness, freshness, consistency), severity routing (P0-P3), ownership registry

critical_gaps.impact: Batch ingestion only, data goes stale, cannot handle event streams
critical_gaps.current_capability: Manual spinner execution or scheduled batch jobs
critical_gaps.required_capability: CDC listeners, webhook handlers, incremental index updates (1000+ events/sec)

critical_gaps.impact: Cannot assess customer readiness, no 'hololoom diagnose' command
critical_gaps.required_capability: Infrastructure assessment tool, gap analysis, timeline estimation, ROI calculator

critical_gaps.impact: Assumes greenfield, no coexistence strategy with Snowflake/Databricks
critical_gaps.required_capability: Phased migration plans, connector libraries, coexistence patterns

principle_1_diagnose_before_deploy.pain_point: Most enterprises fail because they deploy AI before verifying data infrastructure can support <5 second queries

deliverables.name: Integration with WeavingOrchestrator
deliverables.changes: Add structured query path alongside semantic retrieval

acceptance_criteria: Can answer 'SELECT inventory FROM products WHERE product_id=X' in <100ms
Can assemble complete customer view (sales+support+billing+shipping) in <5s
100% backward compatible with existing semantic queries

risks.risk: Neo4j query timeout on complex JOINs
risks.mitigation: Pre-compute common joins as materialized views
Create indexes during low-traffic windows, use read replicas

acceptance_criteria: Can ingest 1000 events/sec for 1 hour without degradation

risks.mitigation: Smart invalidation (only affected entities), batch invalidation

principle_1_diagnose_before_deploy.parallel_work: Phases 1A and 1B can run in parallel (saves 6 weeks)
principle_1_diagnose_before_deploy.critical_path: 1C depends on 1A (need structured query before streaming)

principle_2_zero_copy_architecture.pain_point: Traditional data warehouses copy data to central location (overnight batch), but AI agents need real-time access to authoritative sources
hololoom_gaps: No live query federation to source systems

deliverables.name: FederatedQueryRouter class
capabilities: Query source systems directly (Salesforce, Jira, Stripe, GitHub)
Smart caching with TTL (not full copy)

deliverables.name: Integration SDK
deliverables.purpose: Allow companies to build custom adapters for proprietary systems

acceptance_criteria: Can query Salesforce + Jira + Stripe in <5s (federated)
Cache hit rate >80% in production workload
Custom adapter can be built in <2 days (SDK usability)
Zero data duplication for cached data (TTL-based expiry)

deliverables.name: CDCListener class
capabilities: Webhook events (Salesforce Platform Events, Stripe webhooks)

acceptance_criteria: Salesforce change triggers cache invalidation in <5s
CDC lag <1 minute (database changes reflected quickly)

risks.mitigation: Retry with exponential backoff, dead letter queue

risks.risk: CDC lag during high write load
risks.mitigation: Parallelize CDC processing, partition by entity

principle_2_zero_copy_architecture.critical_path: 2C depends on 2A+2B (need federation + caching before CDC)

principle_3_context_matters_more_than_vo.pain_point: 49% draw incorrect conclusions because data lacks business context (e.g., $2M revenue without 'one-time' flag gets added to ARR incorrectly)
hololoom_gaps: Context in text, not structured fields

deliverables.name: BusinessOntology class
capabilities: Define business concepts (ARR, MRR, churn, active customer)

deliverables.name: Query resolver
deliverables.capability: Translate 'What's our ARR?' into structured query with business logic

example.structured_query: SELECT SUM(revenue_amount) FROM revenue WHERE revenue_type='recurring' AND period='annual'

acceptance_criteria: Can define 20+ core business concepts (ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, churn, etc.)
Query 'What's our ARR?' returns CORRECT answer (excludes one-time)
Business analyst can add new concepts without code changes
Validation rules prevent incorrect data entry

risks.risk: Business definitions unclear or disputed between teams
risks.mitigation: Governance process for approving definitions, version control

risks.risk: Calculation logic too complex for declarative syntax
risks.mitigation: Support both declarative (simple) and Python UDF (complex)

deliverables.name: SchemaValidator class
capabilities: Validate data against schema before storage
Raise ValidationError on missing required fields

acceptance_criteria: RevenueRecord REQUIRES revenue_type field (no more missing context)
Validation fails if revenue_type not in ['recurring', 'one-time']
100% of ingested data validated before storage
Validation failure logged with owner notification

risks.risk: Existing data doesn't conform to schema (backfill required)
risks.mitigation: Backfill tool, ML-based classification for missing fields

acceptance_criteria: Can query Cube metrics OR use HoloLoom semantic layer (choice)
Business definitions centralized (single source of truth)

principle_3_context_matters_more_than_vo.parallel_work: Phases 3B and 3C can overlap with 3A (saves 6 weeks)
principle_3_context_matters_more_than_vo.critical_path: 3A → 3B → 3C (ontology required before schemas, schemas before semantic layer)

principle_4_governance_enables_speed.pain_point: If nobody owns data quality, data will not be quality. Governance = accountability (automated), not bureaucracy (manual approvals)

deliverables.name: DataQualityMonitor class
capabilities: Quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, validity, uniqueness)
Severity-based routing (P0=page on-call, P1=Slack+ticket, P2=ticket, P3=log)
quality_dimensions: Completeness: % of records with all required fields

acceptance_criteria: P0 violation triggers page within 60 seconds
P1 violation creates Slack alert + Jira ticket
Automated remediation fixes 50%+ of P2/P3 issues

risks.mitigation: Tune severity thresholds, batch similar alerts
Quality rule validation period, feedback loop

deliverables.name: Example data assets
assets: customer_records (owner: bob@company.com, SLA: 98% complete, 1h fresh, 100% unique)

acceptance_criteria: Every dataset has exactly one owner (accountability)
Owner receives alerts when SLA violated

deliverables.name: GovernanceDashboard class
views: Asset status (per dataset quality, SLA compliance)

principle_4_governance_enables_speed.parallel_work: Phases 4B and 4C can overlap with 4A (saves 4 weeks)
principle_4_governance_enables_speed.critical_path: 4A → 4B → 4C (monitoring required before ownership, ownership before dashboard)

principle_5_honest_timeline.pain_point: Vendors promise 6 months, reality is 18-36 months. Honest timeline prevents blame cycles and sets realistic expectations
hololoom_gaps: No migration plan for existing enterprises

acceptance_criteria: Timeline estimate within ±4 months of actual (80% accuracy)
Tested with at least 2 customer pilots
ROI calculation matches reality within ±20% (validated with pilots)

principle_5_honest_timeline.parallel_work: All phases can run in parallel (saves 12 weeks)

principle_6_close_perception_gap.pain_point: 63% of executives think they're data-driven, but technical leaders know they're not. Misaligned expectations lead to blame cycles
principle_6_close_perception_gap.hololoom_approach: Assessment tool surfaces gap, honest timeline manages expectations, technical leaders educate executives
principle_6_close_perception_gap.implementation: Already covered in Principle 5 (assessment tool makes gap visible)

additional_deliverables.name: Executive briefing templates
additional_deliverables.purpose: Help technical leaders communicate data readiness to business

additional_deliverables.name: Business-technical alignment workshop
additional_deliverables.outcome: Aligned understanding of timeline, investment, and ROI

principle_7_strategic_choice_time_bound.pain_point: Data runs on a clock. 18-36 months regardless, better to start now than wait (exponential lag)
principle_7_strategic_choice_time_bound.hololoom_message: Start infrastructure work today, run pilots in parallel, scale as foundation solidifies
principle_7_strategic_choice_time_bound.implementation: Philosophy, not code. Communicate urgency in marketing, sales, onboarding

activities: Deploy single use case (e.g., customer support automation)
success_criteria: Agent accuracy >90% on pilot use case
Measurable ROI (e.g., 30% reduction in support tickets)

total_investment.note: This is HoloLoom platform development, not customer deployment

business_kpis.metric: Agent accuracy on pilot use case

mitigation: Negotiate SLAs with API providers (Salesforce, etc.)

technical_risks.risk: Incremental indexing too slow for real-time
CDC lag during high write load

business_risks.risk: Customers won't wait 24 months (vendor offers 6 months)
mitigation: Compete on honesty and long-term value, not timeline promises
Show pilot results early (proof of value)
Offer phased pricing (pay as you go, not upfront)

business_risks.risk: Customer infrastructure assessment reveals 36+ month timeline
mitigation: Qualify customers early (don't waste time on unprepared)
Offer infrastructure consulting (we help fix their data, then deploy HoloLoom)
Focus on 'ready' customers first (build track record)
Conservative benefit estimates (30% support reduction, not 50%)
Start with high-value use cases (support automation > sales productivity)
Customer success team monitors leading indicators
Ramp team gradually (start with 3-4, grow to 9 over 3 months)
Use contractors for non-core work (dashboard UI, etc.)
Prioritize ruthlessly (cut scope if team growth stalls)
Overlap new hires with existing team (handoff period)

go_if: Willing to invest $1.3M over 9 months (platform development)
Accept 24-30 month timeline to customer production (honest)
Have 2-3 pilot customers willing to wait (design partners)
Executive alignment on long-term investment (not quick win)
no_go_if: No pilot customers willing to wait (market validation failure)
Executive pressure for quick wins (misaligned incentives)

must_have_minimum_viable: 1A: Structured Query Engine (P0 blocker for <5s queries)
3A: Business Ontology (P0 blocker for correct answers)
4A: Data Quality Monitoring (P0 blocker for governance)
5A: Infrastructure Assessment (P0 blocker for customer qualification)
nice_to_have_defer_if_needed: 2C: CDC Integration (can start with batch, add streaming later)
3C: Semantic Layer Integration (can use HoloLoom native, skip Cube)
4C: Governance Dashboard (can use logs/Slack, add UI later)
5C: ROI Calculator (can use spreadsheet, automate later)

immediate_week_1.deliverable: Commit to investment OR pivot strategy

month_3_checkpoint.deliverable: 30% of Phase 1 complete (Structured Query Engine alpha)

month_6_checkpoint.deliverable: Structured queries, diagnostics, federation, streaming, ontology, quality monitoring all production-ready
month_6_checkpoint.criteria: All acceptance criteria met, pilot customer validates

month_6_checkpoint.action: Begin Phase 3 (Pilot Deployment) with first customer
month_6_checkpoint.deliverable: Single use case deployed in shadow mode

month_9_checkpoint.deliverable: Governance dashboard, assessment tool, migration playbooks all ready
Agent accuracy >90% on pilot use case, measurable ROI
month_9_checkpoint.criteria: Customer willing to expand to more use cases

month_9_checkpoint.deliverable: Scale to 5-10 customers OR iterate based on pilot learnings
